edits.old: Scenario: AC10 The business rules of section 8 hold (new)
edits.new:
Scenario: AC3 A role without the right or an out-of-scope caller is refused (new)
    Given the role does not hold right C or U of Treatment and offer, or the caller is out of scope
    When the caller acts on the create or the filing
    Then the system answers 403 with MSG-P4-002 before any read or write, and no record is written

  Scenario: AC4 A required element is absent or invalid (new)
    Given a required element of the claim, the collateral fact or the appraisal is absent or invalid
    When the branch is run
    Then the branch does not run, nothing is written and the missing element is named with MSG-GEN-001

  Scenario: AC5 The collateral or its last appraisal is missing, stale or unreadable (new)
    Given the collateral of the case or its last appraisal is missing, stale or not readable through the owner's contract
    When the branch is run
    Then the branch holds, names the missing fact and raises a task, and no claim is created on an unread fact

  Scenario: AC6 A stale version or a repeated Idempotency-Key (new)
    Given the claim's version is stale, or the same create arrives twice with one Idempotency-Key
    When the create is sent
    Then a stale version is answered 409 with nothing written, and a repeated key gets the first answer with no second claim

  Scenario: AC7 The case signal is not accepted or the workflow is waiting (new)
    Given the case signal is not accepted by the parent, or the workflow is waiting and the record is behind
    When the re-appraisal request is reported
    Then the claim stays filed, the request is reported again on the next signal and the claim is never re-filed by the retry

  Scenario: AC8 No component reaches a table or schema it does not own (new)
    Given a component, a statement or a test reaches recovery_case, v_ace_collateral, v_ace_valuation, another service's schema or a v_ace_* view
    When the build scan and the boundary test run
    Then the grant refuses the statement, the boundary test fails the build and nothing is released

  Scenario: AC10 The business rules of section 8 hold (new)

edits.old: Then no second row is created
edits.new:
Then no second row is created

  Scenario: AC13 A consumed event is delivered twice (new)
    Given a consumed event has been processed
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then no second effect is recorded

  Scenario: AC14 An activity is retried or times out (new)
    Given an activity of this service is started
    When the activity is retried or times out
    Then the retry creates no second claim and the timed-out activity writes nothing

  Scenario: AC15 A consumed call fails or does not answer (new)
    Given a consumed call to another service fails or does not answer
    When the branch reads or requests through that call
    Then the branch holds, nothing is written and no claim is created on the unanswered fact

  Scenario: AC16 A status change the model does not allow is refused (new)
    Given the claim is in a status from which the requested change is not allowed by the model
    When the change is requested
    Then the change is refused, nothing is written and the claim keeps its status
